title: Design system board
description: Product teams: colours, type, spacing, corners and shadows as one editable board.
forWho: Product teams keeping one design system

spec.useCase: Ilse Marchetti keeps her studio's colours, type, spacing, corners and shadows in one place her team edits.

business.name: Fernwick Design Co.
business.describes: A small product design studio that keeps one design system for its apps.

tables.name: Colors
tables.describes: Every colour the product uses, light and dark, and what each is read on.
tables.subject: thing

values.name: background
values.usage_note: The page itself. Everything else sits on it.

values.name: foreground
values.usage_note: Body text and icons on the page, on cards and on muted fills.

values.name: card
values.usage_note: Raised panels and cards.

values.name: card-foreground
values.usage_note: Text inside a card.

values.name: popover
values.usage_note: Menus, tooltips and pickers that float over content.

values.name: popover-foreground
values.usage_note: Text inside a menu or tooltip.

values.name: muted
values.usage_note: Quiet fills: table headers, empty states, code blocks.

values.name: muted-foreground
values.usage_note: Hints and captions. Also reads on the page and on cards.

values.name: primary
values.usage_note: The fill of the one main action. Not a text colour: use link.

values.name: primary-foreground
values.usage_note: Label on a primary button.

values.name: secondary
values.usage_note: Second actions and quiet selected states.

values.name: secondary-foreground
values.usage_note: Label on a secondary button.

values.name: accent
values.usage_note: Highlights: a selected row, a tip, something new.

values.name: accent-foreground
values.usage_note: Text on an accent fill. Never put plain foreground on accent.

values.name: link
values.usage_note: Coloured text: links and active tabs. Also reads on cards.

values.name: border
values.usage_note: Edges of controls and outline buttons; 3:1 so they are found.

values.name: input
values.usage_note: The outline of a field and an off switch.

values.name: divider
values.usage_note: Hairlines between rows and around cards. Decorative only.

values.name: ring
values.usage_note: Keyboard focus. Always visible, never removed.

values.name: destructive
values.usage_note: Errors and delete. Also reads on the page and on cards.

values.name: destructive-foreground
values.usage_note: Label on a delete button.

values.name: success
values.usage_note: Done, live, saved. Always paired with a word.

values.name: warning
values.usage_note: Waiting or at risk. Always paired with a word.

tables.name: Typography
tables.describes: The text styles: font, weight, size, line height and spacing.
tables.subject: thing

values.name: display
values.usage_note: One per page at most: a landing headline.

values.name: title
values.usage_note: The page title.

values.name: heading
values.usage_note: Section headings inside a page.

values.name: body
values.usage_note: Everything people read.

values.name: label
values.usage_note: Buttons, field labels and tabs.

values.name: caption
values.usage_note: Labels over values, timestamps, small print.

values.name: code
values.usage_note: Code, ids and values people copy.

tables.name: Spacing
tables.describes: The spacing scale every layout is built from, and the height of controls.
tables.subject: thing

values.name: space-1
values.usage_note: Between an icon and its label.

values.name: space-2
values.usage_note: Between related controls in a row.

values.name: space-3
values.usage_note: Inside a compact card; between a label and its field.

values.name: space-4
values.usage_note: Padding of a card or a dialog.

values.name: space-6
values.usage_note: Between groups inside a section.

values.name: space-8
values.usage_note: Between sections of a page.

values.name: control-height
values.usage_note: The height of buttons, fields and rows people press.

tables.name: Corner radius
tables.describes: How round corners are, from chips to avatars.
tables.subject: thing

values.name: radius-sm
values.usage_note: Tags, checkboxes and small chips.

values.name: radius-md
values.usage_note: Buttons, fields and menus (also --radius).

values.name: radius-lg
values.usage_note: Cards, dialogs and panels.

values.name: radius-full
values.usage_note: Avatars, pills and switches.

tables.name: Shadows
tables.describes: Elevation: how far something floats above the page, in light and dark.
tables.subject: thing

values.name: shadow-sm
values.usage_note: Cards resting on the page.

values.name: shadow-md
values.usage_note: Menus and popovers over content.

values.name: shadow-lg
values.usage_note: Dialogs, the highest layer on screen.

tables.name: Components
tables.describes: Each component family, drawn as it looks in light and dark, with where to use it.
tables.subject: thing

values.name: Button
values.usage_note: The one main action of a screen. Never two side by side.

values.name: Button variants
values.usage_note: Secondary, outline and quiet for everything else; danger only for what cannot be undone.

values.name: Text field
values.usage_note: A visible label above, a hint or the error below; the error names the fix.

values.name: Card
values.sample:
Report

Quarterly report

Updated 2 hours ago by Dana
values.usage_note: One idea per card: a kicker, a title, one line of detail, at most two actions.

values.name: Badge
values.sample: DraftNewLiveWaitingFailed
values.usage_note: A status always pairs its colour with a word.

values.name: Toggle list
values.usage_note: A switch acts at once. When a choice needs a Save, use a checkbox.

values.name: Collapsible list
values.sample:
What is included

Every table, view and page in the template.

Who can see it

Everyone in your organization.

Can I undo it

Yes, from the history of each item.
values.usage_note: For answers people look up once. Never hide a step people must take.

values.name: Tabs
values.usage_note: Tabs switch views of one thing. Three to five short names.

values.name: Select and search
values.usage_note: A select for a short fixed list; a search box when the list is long.

values.name: Checkbox and radio
values.usage_note: Checkboxes for several choices; radios for exactly one.

tables.name: Opacity
tables.describes: How see-through things get: disabled controls, tints and overlays.
tables.subject: thing

values.name: opacity-disabled
values.usage_note: A control that cannot be used yet.

values.name: opacity-hover
values.usage_note: The tint laid over a row or a button on hover.

values.name: opacity-overlay
values.usage_note: The dim behind a dialog.

tables.name: Motion
tables.describes: How fast things move and how they ease in and out.
tables.subject: thing

values.name: motion-fast
values.usage_note: Hover, press and focus.

values.name: motion-base
values.usage_note: Menus, popovers and things arriving.

values.name: motion-slow
values.usage_note: Dialogs, side panels and page changes.

tiles.title: Design system
tiles.hero:
Design system

One look,
every screen.

The colours, type, spacing and components every screen is built from, kept in one place.

ColorsTypographySpacingComponents
tiles.text:
## Principles

- **Clear before clever.** Every screen says what it is for in its first line.
- **One way to do one thing.** A colour, a size or a component has one name.
- **Calm by default.** Colour is for meaning, never for decoration.

## Using tokens

Use a token by its name, never its value. Change a value here and every screen and every component sample below follows: colours, type, spacing, corners, shadows, opacity and motion. Each colour shows its light and dark values and is checked against the colour it is read on.

## Using components

Build screens from the components in this system. Each one is drawn below in its states, with a note on when to use it. When one is missing, add a row to Components.

## Accessibility

Text reaches 4.5:1 against what it sits on; control edges and focus 3:1. Focus is always visible. Nothing is told by colour alone.
